```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaps)

# (2) Read data (change path to where you saved the csv)
df_raw <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat/players_champion_perf_wide_2.csv")

```

```{r}
df_change <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # percent/log change in market value
    pct_change_mp = if_else(
      value_2021 > 0 & value_2022 > 0,
      log(value_2022) - log(value_2021),
      NA_real_
    ),

    champion_2021 = if_else(rank_2021 == 1, 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(pct_change_mp)) %>%
  mutate(
    # categorical variables
    champion_2021 = factor(champion_2021),
    main_position = factor(main_position),
    foot          = factor(foot),
    citizenship   = factor(citizenship),
    is_eu         = factor(is_eu)
  )

```

```{r}
df_change <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # percent/log change in market value 2021 -> 2022
    pct_change_mp = if_else(
      value_2021 > 0 & value_2022 > 0,
      (value_2022-value_2021)/value_2021,
      NA_real_
    ),
    # champion indicator based on rank_2021
    champion_2021 = if_else(rank_2021 == 1, 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(pct_change_mp)) %>%
  mutate(
    champion_2021 = factor(champion_2021),
    main_position = factor(main_position),
    foot          = factor(foot),
    is_eu         = factor(is_eu)
  )

summary(df_change$pct_change_mp)
```

```{r}
df_screen <- df_change %>%
  select(
    value_2022,          # response

    # treatment variable INCLUDED as predictor candidate
    #champion_2021,

    # 2021 performance stats
    goals_2021,
    assists_2021,
    nb_in_group_2021,
    nb_on_pitch_2021,
    own_goals_2021,
    subed_in_2021,
    subed_out_2021,
    yellow_cards_2021,
    second_yellow_cards_2021,
    direct_red_cards_2021,
    penalty_goals_2021,
    minutes_played_2021,
    clean_sheets_2021,
    
    
    #value_2021,

    # player attributes
    #height,
    #main_position,
    foot,
    is_eu
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

str(df_screen)
```

```{r}

best.mods <- regsubsets(
  value_2022 ~ .,
  data   = df_screen,
  nvmax  = ncol(df_screen) - 1,
  method = "exhaustive"
)

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
plot(
  best.mods,
  scale = "adjr2",
  col = "black",
  col.axis = "black",
  col.lab = "black",
  main = "Best Subsets ",
  cex.axis = 0.8,
  cex.lab  = 0.8
)

best.sum <- summary(best.mods)
best.sum


```

```{r}
mod_reduced <- lm(
  value_2022 ~ goals_2021+assists_2021+nb_in_group_2021,
  data = df_change
)
summary(mod_reduced)
```

```{r}
df_model <- df_change %>%
  select(pct_change_mp,
         goals_2021,
         subed_out_2021,
         penalty_goals_2021,
         champion_2021) %>%
  drop_na()   # removes rows with any NA in these columns

nrow(df_model)
```


```{r}
mod_reduced <- lm(
  pct_change_mp ~ goals_2021 + subed_out_2021 + penalty_goals_2021,
  data = df_model
)

mod_full <- lm(
  pct_change_mp ~ goals_2021 + subed_out_2021 + penalty_goals_2021 + champion_2021,
  data = df_model
)

summary(mod_reduced)
summary(mod_full)
```

```{r}
anova(mod_reduced, mod_full)
```

```{r}
df_model$resid  <- resid(mod_reduced)
df_model$fitted <- fitted(mod_reduced)
df_model$order  <- seq_len(nrow(df_model))
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_model, aes(fitted, resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="red", linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title="Residuals vs Fitted (Reduced Model)",
       x="Fitted pct_change_mp", y="Residuals") +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
ggplot(df_model, aes(order, resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.6) +
  geom_line(alpha=.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="red", linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title="Residuals vs Observation Order",
       y="Residuals") +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
ggplot(df_model, aes(sample=resid)) +
  stat_qq(alpha=.7) +
  stat_qq_line(color="red") +
  labs(title="Normal Q-Q (Reduced Model)") +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
for (v in c("goals_2021","subed_out_2021","penalty_goals_2021")) {
  print(
    ggplot(df_model, aes_string(v, "resid")) +
      geom_point(alpha=.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="red", linetype="dashed") +
      labs(title=paste("Residuals vs", v)) +
      theme_bw()
  )
}

```

```{r}
beta_champ <- coef(mod_full)["champion_20211"]
pct_effect <- (exp(beta_champ) - 1) * 100
pct_effect
```
